tool.name: DSPy
tool.summary: Stanford NLP's framework for algorithmically optimizing language model prompts, weights, and retrieval parameters via declarative modules and automatic teleprompters.
tool.architecture: Declarative LM programming framework with compiler/optimizer loop.
tool.benchmarks: Improves pipeline accuracy by 25%-40% compared to static prompt chains.
tool.limitations: Requires learning module abstractions rather than writing raw prompt strings.
